subtitle: Next.js frontend powered by a NestJS API with JWT authentication. Admins manage products and users, while regular users browse the catalog.

features.title: Role-based access
features.description: Admin and user roles with distinct permissions, enforced on both API and UI.

features.title: Product catalog
features.description: Admins create and manage products; every authenticated user can browse them.

features.title: User management
features.description: Admins can view, update and delete accounts from a paginated table.

features.title: Secure by default
features.description: Bcrypt-hashed passwords and JWT tokens signed and verified on every request.

ctaSubtitle: Sign in with your account and explore the dashboard.
footer: ShopWave — modern ecommerce, built to scale.
